title: 7 Factors 5 Joy
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett takes up joy, the fifth of the seven factors of awakening, beginning with Buddhaghosa's passage in the Visuddhimagga that separates pīti (joy) from sukha (happiness) through the image of an exhausted traveler in the desert who hears about a pond. Nomon offers three ways to cultivate joy: loosening identification with thinking, engaging fully with relationships and the senses, and working directly with desire by staying in it or doing the opposite of what it demands. Thich Nhat Hanh's Google talk, whose whole message is "you have to be here," and a recent quarrel on vacation serve as examples. Nomon closes by dedicating the evening to Paul Warwick, who has severe leukemia, advises trusting emptiness and preparing for death, and keeps a Trungpa Rinpoche calligraphy on his wall that means courage.
